Definition

Let $M$ be a smooth manifold, possibly with boundary, and let $p\in M$. A derivation at $p$ is an $\mathbb {R}$-linear map $v:C^\infty (M)\to \mathbb {R}$ such that \[ v(fg)=f(p)v(g)+g(p)v(f)qquad \text{for all }f,g\in C^\infty (M). \tag {3.4} \] The vector space of derivations at $p$ is the tangent space $T_pM$; its elements are tangent vectors at $p$.
